---
applyTo: "site/_maps/**"
---
# site/_maps/ — Auto-generated files

These files are **overwritten automatically** by `cicd/update-maps/sync_maps.py`,
which pulls map metadata from the TripleA server. Manual edits will be lost on the next sync.

To make a permanent change to a map entry:
- Edit the source data or the sync script in `cicd/update-maps/`
- Do **not** edit `site/_maps/*.html` directly
